description:
List your Kling generation tasks (Kling returns them newest first) with pagination. Use to find a recent task_id (for check_kling_task) or a video id (for extend_kling_video / generate_kling_lip_sync) without having saved it.

TASK TYPES: "text2video", "image2video", "video-extend", "lip-sync", "image" (one list per type).
PAGINATION: when has_more is true, call again with page = next_page to continue.
NOTE: result URLs expire 30 days after generation — use download_kling_video to save outputs you want to keep.

task_type.description: Which task list to query. Default: text2video

name: list_kling_tasks
